detail.scope_note: Six independent finite safety projections extending EmailSwitchboardHarmony; 32 satellite authentication vectors; command/link classes; partial/cleared/uncleared receipts, candidate notices, approval then reversal and send-time recheck; two orgs with two fingerprints each and atomic row-lock/rollback abstraction; OTP request time/authentication/private-target classes; source/chunk category pairs. Each projection exhausts all its enabled interleavings. Not a combined cross-product proof or liveness proof; PostgreSQL race tests validate the lock abstraction. Sent-folder truth is a trusted ingestor boundary, not established by the model.
